message.reasoning_content:
need to identify crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: Using software to exploit vulnerability, illegally withdraw money from payment platform: theft (盗窃罪) of public and private property, amount large. Also teaching others method: "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪"? Actually teaching method to commit theft: could be "帮助他人实施盗窃罪" or "组织、领导、参加黑社会性质组织"? Not. Under Chinese law, providing means for others to commit crime can be "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪" (Article 287-1). Since using network and software, could be "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". Also "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪"? The act of using fiddler to capture packets and withdraw money could be "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" (Article 285). But the core is theft of money via computer. Chinese law has "盗窃罪" and "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" and "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". The prosecution says "以非法占有为目的，采用秘密手段，窃取公私财物，数额较大，应当以××追究其刑事责任。被告人倪某向他人传授犯罪方法，应当以××追究其刑事责任。" Likely they will charge "盗窃罪" and "帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪". Also possibly "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪". But the fact says "利用fiddler软件抓包的方式无限提现的信息后...非法窃取...". That is theft via computer. Chinese law treats that as theft (盗窃罪) if using computer to steal money. Also "非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪" is about obtaining data, not money. So likely theft.

Thus answer: 盗窃罪;帮助信息网络犯罪活动罪<eoa>
